You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies, at the TLA+ level, the translation from the abstract syntax tree of a global-naming PlusCal (+CAL) algorithm into a TLA+ specification. It defines the grammar of legal abstract syntax trees for algorithms, procedures, processes, labeled statements, and related constructs, and then defines operators that translate such trees into lexeme sequences representing TLA+ output, including Init, Next, Spec, and a Termination property. The file also models fairness options for the generated specification, supporting no fairness, weak fairness of process actions, weak fairness of Next, and strong fairness of process actions; it is designed as an executable specification for TLC, with numerous comments about representation hacks, limitations, formatting omissions, and error cases in translation.
